metadata.description: Vessels that appear in the AIS, port-call and incident data. Vessel, owner and operator names are fictional; government agencies are real. MMSI prefixes match the flag. IMO numbers carry valid check digits but are not real ships.
metadata.joins: mmsi joins AIS (MMSI) and supply/vessel_arrivals.csv (mmsi); home_berth_id and usual_berths join terminal_registry.json (berths[].berth_id, slips[].slip_id, terminals[].terminal_id); sea_gates joins terminal_registry.json sea_gates[].gate_id.

fields.deep_draft: true when the vessel needs the dredged 40 ft+ ship channel inside the port
fields.draft_m: maximum (laden) draft; draft_ballast_m is the light draft
fields.transceiver_class: A, B, or null when the hull carries no AIS transponder
